Ok(None)\n150\t}\n151\t```\n152\t\n153\tThis means field-based project detection is **parser-specific**, not scraper-level.\n154\t\n155\t#### Parser Implementation\n156\t\n157\tDifferent parsers metadata with the `working_dir` field. Envelope System for First-Line Metadata\n217\t\n218\t### 3.1 What is the Envelope System?\n219\t\n220\tAgentScribe has an **envelope unwrapping system** for handling wrapped JSONL lines where event data is nested inside a wrapper structure (like Codex's `{type, timestamp, payload}` format).\n221\t\n222\t### 3.2 Envelope Configuration\n223\t\n224\t```toml\n225\t[source.envelope]\n226\tpayload_field = \"payload\"    # Field containing actual event data\n227\ttype_field = \"type\"          # Field for routing decisions\n228\ttype_routing = {             # Maps type values to actions\n229\t    message = \"event\",       # → produce canonical events\n230\t    session = \"skip\",        # → ignore this line\n231\t    compaction = \"meta\"      # → accumulate metadata (future)\n232\t}\n233\t```\n234\t\n235\t### 3.3 Routing Actions\n236\t\n237\t- **`\"event\"`**: Extract payload, produce canonical events\n238\t- **`\"skip\"`**: Ignore this line entirely\n239\t- **`\"meta\"`**: Accumulate metadata (not yet fully implemented - returns `Vec::new()`)\n240\t\n241\t### 3.4 Does Goose Need Envelope Unwrapping?\n242\t\n243\t**Current goose plugin**: No envelope configured\n244\t\n245\t**Schema analysis**: Looking at the goose format:\n246\t- Line 1: `{working_dir, description, ...}` - no `type` field, no wrapper\n247\t- Message lines: `{role, created, content[]}` - no wrapper\n248\t\n249\t**Conclusion**: Goose does **NOT** need envelope unwrapping. It's a flat JSONL structure.\n250\t\n251\tThe first line is just a different JSON schema than subsequent lines, not a wrapped structure.\n252\t\n253\t### 3.5 How First-Line Metadata Should Work for Goose\n254\t\n255\tSince goose doesn't use envelope unwrapping, the project extraction should work as follows:\n256\t\n257\t1. **JSONL parser reads first line**: Parse as JSON\n258\t2. **Extract `working_dir` field**: Use the `ProjectDetection::Field { field: \"working_dir\" }` config\n259\t3. **Create ParseContext with project**: \n260\t   ```rust\n261\t   let project = extract_string(&first_line_json, \"working_dir\");\n262\t   let context = ParseContext::new(session_id, source_agent, source_file)\n263\t       .with_project(project);\n264\t   ```\n265\t4. **Parse rest of file with context**: All events get the project from context\n266\t\n267\t## 4. Goose Plugin Schema\n\n### 1.1 Data Location\n\n- **Path**: `~/.local/share/goose/sessions/*.jsonl`\n- **Format**: JSONL (one JSON object per line)\n\n### 1.2 File Structure\n\nGoose session files have a specific two-part structure:\n\n#### **Line 1: Session Metadata**\n\n```json\n{\n  \"working_dir\": \"/home/coding/projects/my-app\",\n  \"description\": \"Debug memory leak in worker process\",\n  \"message_count\": 4,\n  \"total_tokens\": 1250,\n  \"input_tokens\": 980,\n  \"output_tokens\": 270,\n  \"accumulated_total_tokens\": 75280,\n  \"accumulated_input_tokens\": 72872,\n  \"accumulated_output_tokens\": 2408\n}\n```\n\n**Key fields:**\n- `working_dir`: **Primary project path field** - absolute path to the project directory\n- `description`: Human-readable session description\n- `message_count`: Number of messages in the session\n- `total_tokens`, `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`: Token counts for this session\n- `accumulated_*`: Cumulative token counts across sessions\n\n#### **Subsequent Lines: Messages**\n\n```json\n{\n  \"role\": \"user\",\n  \"created\": 1747178328,\n  \"content\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"text\",\n      \"text\": \"I'm seeing a memory leak in my worker process. Can you help me investigate?\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n**Message fields:**\n- `role`: \"user\" or \"assistant\"\n- `created`: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch)\n- `content`: Array of content blocks (text, toolRequest, toolResponse)\n\n### 1.3 Content Block Types\n\nThe `content` array contains blocks of different types that AgentScribe expands into canonical events:\n\n#### Text Block\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"text\",\n  \"text\": \"I have started a basic mcp template...\"\n}\n```\n→ Becomes message content text\n\n#### Tool Request Block\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"toolRequest\",\n  \"id\": \"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\",\n  \"toolCall\": {\n    \"status\": \"success\",\n    \"value\": {\n      \"name\": \"developer__shell\",\n      \"arguments\": {\n        \"command\": \"ls -la\"\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n→ Expands to `tool_call` event (extracts tool name from `toolCall.value.name`)\n\n#### Tool Response Block\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"toolResponse\",\n  \"id\": \"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\",\n  \"toolResult\": {\n    \"status\": \"success\",\n    \"value\": [...]\n  }\n}\n```\n→ Expands to `tool_result` event (correlated with tool_call by `id`)\n\n### 1.4 Required Fields for Plugin Configuration\n\nFor goose, the essential field mappings are:\n\n| Canonical Field | Source Field | Notes |\n|----------------|--------------|-------|\n| `timestamp` | `created` | Unix timestamp (seconds) |\n| `role` | `role` | \"user\" or \"assistant\" |\n| `content` | `content` | Array of content blocks |\n| `project` | `working_dir` | From first-line metadata (line 1) |\n\n## 2. Project Detection Mechanisms\n\n### 2.1 ProjectDetection Enum\n\nAgentScribe supports three project detection strategies defined in `src/plugin.rs`:\n\n```rust\npub enum ProjectDetection {\n    Field { field: String },  // Extract from a JSON field\n    ParentDir,                // Use parent directory of log file\n    GitRoot,                  // Use git repository root\n}\n```\n\n### 2.2 How ProjectDetection::Field Works\n\n#### Configuration (in `plugins/goose.toml`)\n\n```toml\n[parser.project]\nmethod = \"field\"\nfield = \"working_dir\"\n```\n\n#### Implementation (from `src/scraper/mod.rs`)\n\nThe scraper's `detect_project()` method handles field-based detection:\n\n```rust\n// Line 663-667 in src/scraper/mod.rs\nProjectDetection::Field { field: _ } => {\n    // For field-based detection, we need to extract from the first event\n    // This is handled in the parser, return None here\n    Ok(None)\n}\n```\n\nThis means field-based project detection is **parser-specific**, not scraper-level.\n\n#### Parser Implementation\n\nDifferent parsers handle field-based project detection differently:\n\n**For JSON Array format** (`src/parser/json_array.rs` lines 175-181):\n\n```rust\n// Set project: prefer field extraction from event, fall back to context\nevent.project =\n    if let Some(ProjectDetection::Field { field }) = plugin.parser.project.as_ref() {\n        extract_string(item, field).or_else(|| context.project.clone())\n    } else {\n        context.project.clone()\n    };\n```\n\nThis extracts the project from **each event item**.\n\n**For JSONL format** (`src/parser/jsonl.rs` line 387):\n\n```rust\n// Set project from context\nevent.project = context.project.clone();\n```\n\nJSONL uses the **ParseContext** to carry project information across all events.\n\n### 2.3 How First-Line Metadata Sets Project\n\nThe key insight is that the first line of goose JSONL files contains the session metadata with the `working_dir` field. Here's how it flows:\n\n1. **Parser reads line 1**: Session metadata with `working_dir`\n2. **Extract project field**: Parser should extract `working_dir` from line 1\n3. **Store in ParseContext**: Project value is stored in `ParseContext.project`\n4. **Apply to all events**: Every subsequent event gets `event.project = context.project.clone()`\n\n#### Current Implementation Gap\n\nLooking at the existing code, there's a **missing implementation** for extracting project from first-line metadata in JSONL format:\n\n- The scraper calls `detect_project()` which returns `Ok(None)` for Field detection\n- The ParseContext is created with `project: None` (line 414 in `src/parser/mod.rs`)\n- Events get `event.project = context.project.clone()` which is `None`\n\n**The missing piece**: The JSONL parser needs to:\n1. Read the first line\n2. Extract the project field (e.g., `working_dir`)\n3. Create ParseContext with that project value\n4. Use that context for parsing all subsequent lines\n\n### 2.4 Alternative: ParentDir Detection\n\nIf field-based detection is not implemented, goose can use `ParentDir`:\n\n```toml\n[parser.project]\nmethod = \"parent_dir\"  # Uses parent directory of session file\n```\n\nThis is simpler but less accurate than using the actual `working_dir` from the session metadata.\n\n## 3. Envelope System for First-Line Metadata\n\n### 3.1 What is the Envelope System?\n\nAgentScribe has an **envelope unwrapping system** for handling wrapped JSONL lines where event data is nested inside a wrapper structure (like Codex's `{type, timestamp, payload}` format).\n\n### 3.2 Envelope Configuration\n\n```toml\n[source.envelope]\npayload_field = \"payload\"    # Field containing actual event data\ntype_field = \"type\"          # Field for routing decisions\ntype_routing = {             # Maps type values to actions\n    message = \"event\",       # → produce canonical events\n    session = \"skip\",        # → ignore this line\n    compaction = \"meta\"      # → accumulate metadata (future)\n}\n```\n\n### 3.3 Routing Actions\n\n- **`\"event\"`**: Extract payload, produce canonical events\n- **`\"skip\"`**: Ignore this line entirely\n- **`\"meta\"`**: Accumulate metadata (not yet fully implemented - returns `Vec::new()`)\n\n### 3.4 Does Goose Need Envelope Unwrapping?\n\n**Current goose plugin**: No envelope configured\n\n**Schema analysis**: Looking at the goose format:\n- Line 1: `{working_dir, description, ...}` - no `type` field, no wrapper\n- Message lines: `{role, created, content[]}` - no wrapper\n\n**Conclusion**: Goose does **NOT** need envelope unwrapping. It's a flat JSONL structure.\n\nThe first line is just a different JSON schema than subsequent lines, not a wrapped structure.\n\n### 3.5 How First-Line Metadata Should Work for Goose\n\nSince goose doesn't use envelope unwrapping, the project extraction should work as follows:\n\n1. **JSONL parser reads first line**: Parse as JSON\n2. **Extract `working_dir` field**: Use the `ProjectDetection::Field { field: \"working_dir\" }` config\n3. **Create ParseContext with project**: \n   ```rust\n   let project = extract_string(&first_line_json, \"working_dir\");\n   let context = ParseContext::new(session_id, source_agent, source_file)\n       .with_project(project);\n   ```\n4. **Parse rest of file with context**: All events get the project from context\n\n## 4. Required Plugin Configuration Fields\n\n### 4.1 Essential Fields for Goose Plugin\n\n```toml\n[plugin]\nname = \"goose\"\nversion = \"1.0\"\n\n[source]\npaths = [\"~/.local/share/goose/sessions/*.jsonl\"]\nformat = \"jsonl\"\n\n[source.session_detection]\nmethod = \"one-file-per-session\"\nsession_id_from = \"filename\"\n\n[parser]\ntimestamp = \"created\"        # Unix timestamp\nrole = \"role\"               # \"user\" or \"assistant\"\ncontent = \"content\"         # Array of content blocks\n\n[parser.static]\nsource_agent = \"goose\"\n\n[parser.project]\nmethod = \"field\"            # Extract from first-line metadata\nfield = \"working_dir\"       # Field name in line 1\n\n[parser.model]\nsource = \"none\"             # Model not available in goose logs\n\n[parser.file_paths]\ncontent_regex = true        # Extract paths from content\n```\n\n### 4.2 Field Value Acceptance\n\n#### timestamp field\n- **Accepts**: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch)\n- **Format**: Integer or string representing seconds\n- **Example**: `1747178328`\n\n#### role field\n- **Accepts**: \"user\" or \"assistant\"\n- **Format**: String\n- **Required**: Yes - every message line must have a role\n\n#### content field\n- **Accepts**: Array of content blocks\n- **Format**: JSON array with objects containing `type` field\n- **Block types**: \"text\", \"toolRequest\", \"toolResponse\"\n\n#### project field (working_dir)\n- **Accepts**: Absolute file path\n- **Format**: String path\n- **Example**: \"/home/coding/projects/my-app\"\n- **Location**: Line 1 only (session metadata)\n\n## 5. Comparison with Other Plugins\n\n### 5.1 vs Claude Code\n\n| Aspect | Goose | Claude Code |\n|--------|-------|-------------|\n| **Session metadata** | Line 1 of JSONL | Separate `session-meta/<uuid>.json` file |\n| **Project field** | `working_dir` | `cwd` |\n| **Timestamp format** | Unix timestamp (`created`) | ISO 8601 (`timestamp`) |\n| **Content structure** | `content[]` array with blocks | Embedded in message with `type` field |\n| **Tool calls** | `toolRequest`/`toolResponse` blocks | `tool_use` content blocks |\n| **Model tracking** | Not available | In metadata file |\n\n### 5.2 vs Codex\n\n| Aspect | Goose | Codex |\n|--------|-------|-------|\n| **Structure** | Flat JSONL | Envelope-wrapped JSONL |\n| **First line** | Session metadata | `RolloutLine::Meta` |\n| **Type routing** | Not needed | Required (skip/meta/event) |\n| **Project field** | `working_dir` (line 1) | `cwd` (in meta) |\n\n## 6. Summary and Recommendations\n\n### 7.1 Schema Requirements\n\nThe goose plugin requires:\n1. **Line 1 handling**: Extract session metadata (`working_dir`, `description`, etc.)\n2. **Field-based project detection**: Implement `ProjectDetection::Field` for JSONL format\n3. **Content array expansion**: Parse `content[]` blocks into canonical events\n4. **Tool correlation**: Match `toolRequest.id` with `toolResponse.id`\n\n### 7.2 Project Detection Field Values\n\nFor goose, the project detection field is:\n- **Field name**: `working_dir`\n- **Location**: Line 1 (first line of JSONL file)\n- **Format**: Absolute file path string\n- **Example value**: `/home/coding/projects/my-app`\n\n### 7.3 Ready to Create Config\n\nWith this understanding, you can create a functional goose plugin configuration using:\n\n1. **Project detection**: `method = \"field\"` with `field = \"working_dir\"` (requires parser implementation) OR `method = \"parent_dir\"` (works immediately)\n2. **Timestamp field**: `timestamp = \"created\"` (Unix timestamp)\n3. **Role field**: `role = \"role\"` (user/assistant)\n4. **Content field**: `content = \"content\"` (array of blocks)\n\n### 7.4 Next Steps\n\nTo fully support goose with accurate project detection:\n\n1. Plugin Configuration Schema\n\n### 1.1 Complete Plugin TOML\n\n```toml\n[plugin]\nname = \"goose\"\nversion = \"1.0\"\n\n[source]\npaths = [\"~/.local/share/goose/sessions/*.jsonl\"]\nexclude = []\nformat = \"jsonl\"\n\n[source.session_detection]\nmethod = \"one-file-per-session\"\nsession_id_from = \"filename\"\n\n[parser]\ntimestamp = \"created\"        # Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch)\nrole = \"role\"               # \"user\" or \"assistant\"\ncontent = \"content\"         # Array of content blocks\n\n[parser.static]\nsource_agent = \"goose\"\n\n[parser.project]\nmethod = \"field\"            # Extract from first-line metadata\nfield = \"working_dir\"       # Field name in session metadata (line 1)\n\n[parser.model]\nsource = \"none\"             # Model information not available in goose logs\n\n[parser.file_paths]\ncontent_regex = true        # Extract file paths from content via regex\n```\n\n### 1.2 Plugin Metadata Fields\n\n| Field | Type | Required | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|-------------|\n| `name` | string | yes | Plugin identifier: \"goose\" |\n| `version` | string | yes | Plugin definition version: \"1.0\" |\n\n---\n\n## 2. Source Configuration\n\n### 2.1 Source Fields\n\n| Field | Type | Required | Values | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|--------|-------------|\n| `paths` | array | yes | glob patterns | `[\"~/.local/share/goose/sessions/*.jsonl\"]` |\n| `exclude` | array | no | glob patterns | Patterns to exclude from matches |\n| `format` | string | yes | `\"jsonl\"` | File format identifier |\n\n### 2.2 Session Detection Fields\n\n| Field | Type | Required | Values | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|--------|-------------|\n| `method` | string | yes | `\"one-file-per-session\"` | Each JSONL file is one session |\n| `session_id_from` | string | yes | `\"filename\"` | Session ID extracted from filename |\n\n---\n\n## 3. All sessions will have `model: null` in the canonical schema.\n\n### 3.5 File Path Extraction Fields\n\n| Field | Value | Type | Description |\n|-------|-------|------|-------------|\n| `content_regex` | `true` | boolean | Extract file paths from content using regex patterns |\n\n---\n\n## 4. 270,\n  \"accumulated_total_tokens\": 75280,\n  \"accumulated_input_tokens\": 72872,\n  \"accumulated_output_tokens\": 2408\n}\n```\n\n**Session Metadata Fields:**\n\n| Field | Type | Required | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|-------------|\n| `working_dir` | string | yes | **Primary project path** - absolute path to project directory |\n| `description` | string | no | Human-readable session description |\n| `message_count` | integer | yes | Number of messages in this session |\n| `total_tokens` | integer | yes | Token count for this session |\n| `input_tokens` | integer | yes | Input tokens for this session |\n| `output_tokens` | integer | yes | Output tokens for this session |\n| `accumulated_total_tokens` | integer | yes | Cumulative total tokens across all sessions |\n| `accumulated_input_tokens` | integer | yes | Cumulative input tokens across all sessions |\n| `accumulated_output_tokens` | integer | yes | Cumulative output tokens across all sessions |\n\n#### **Subsequent Lines: Message Events**\n\n```json\n{\n  \"role\": \"user\",\n  \"created\": 1747178328,\n  \"content\": [...]\n}\n```\n\n**Message Event Fields:**\n\n| Field | Type | Required | Values | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|--------|-------------|\n| `role` | string | yes | `\"user\"` or `\"assistant\"` | Message role |\n| `created` | integer | yes | Unix timestamp | Seconds since epoch |\n| `content` | array | yes | Content blocks | Array of content block objects (see §4.2) |\n\n### 4.2 Content Block Types\n\nThe `content` array contains blocks of different types that AgentScribe expands into canonical events:\n\n#### Type 1: Text Block\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"text\",\n  \"text\": \"I have started a basic mcp template...\"\n}\n```\n\n**Fields:**\n- `type`: \"text\"\n- `text`: String content of the message\n\n→ Becomes message content text in canonical event\n\n#### Type 2: Tool Request Block\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"toolRequest\",\n  \"id\": \"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\",\n  \"toolCall\": {\n    \"status\": \"success\",\n    \"value\": {\n      \"name\": \"developer__shell\",\n      \"arguments\": {\n        \"command\": \"ls -la\"\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Fields:**\n- `type`: \"toolRequest\"\n- `id`: Tool correlation ID (matches with toolResponse)\n- `toolCall.status`: \"success\" or other status\n- `toolCall.value.name`: Tool name (e.g., \"developer__shell\")\n- `toolCall.value.arguments`: Tool parameters object\n\n→ Expands to `tool_call` canonical event\n\n#### Type 3: Tool Response Block\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"toolResponse\",\n  \"id\": \"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\",\n  \"toolResult\": {\n    \"status\": \"success\",\n    \"value\": [...]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Fields:**\n- `type`: \"toolResponse\"\n- `id`: Tool correlation ID (matches with toolRequest)\n- `toolResult.status`: \"success\" or other status\n- `toolResult.value`: Tool output (can be nested content blocks)\n\n→ Expands to `tool_result` canonical event\n\n---\n\n## 5. Field Constraints and Validation\n\n### 5.1 Timestamp Field\n\n**Field name:** `created`\n\n**Acceptable values:**\n- Format: Integer (Unix timestamp)\n- Unit: Seconds since epoch\n- Example: `1747178328`\n\n**Constraints:**\n- Must be parseable as integer\n- Represents seconds (not milliseconds)\n- No ISO 8601 format support\n\n### 5.2 Role Field\n\n**Field name:** `role`\n\n**Acceptable values:**\n- `\"user\"` - User message\n- `\"assistant\"` - Assistant message\n\n**Constraints:**\n- Required on all message lines\n- Must be lowercase string\n- No other roles supported (no \"system\", \"tool\", etc. in base role field)\n\n### 5.3 Content Field\n\n**Field name:** `content`\n\n**Acceptable values:**\n- Format: JSON array of content block objects\n- Each block must have `type` field\n- Supported types: \"text\", \"toolRequest\", \"toolResponse\"\n\n**Constraints:**\n- Required on all message lines\n- Must be valid JSON array\n- Cannot be null or undefined\n- Array can contain multiple blocks (e.g., text + toolRequest)\n\n### 5.4 Project Field (working_dir)\n\n**Field name:** `working_dir`\n\n**Acceptable values:**\n- Format: Absolute file path string\n- Example: `\"/home/coding/projects/my-app\"`\n\n**Constraints:**\n- Located in line 1 only (session metadata)\n- Must be absolute path (starts with `/`)\n- Should be valid directory path\n- Not present on message lines\n\n---\n\n## 6. Event Expansion Rules\n\nAgentScribe expands goose content blocks into canonical events as follows:\n\n### 7.1 Text Block → Message Content\n\n```json\n{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"Hello world\"}\n```\n\n→ Canonical event:\n```json\n{\n  \"role\": \"user\",\n  \"content\": \"Hello world\"\n}\n```\n\n### 7.2 Tool Request → tool_call Event\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"toolRequest\",\n  \"id\": \"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\",\n  \"toolCall\": {\n    \"status\": \"success\",\n    \"value\": {\n      \"name\": \"developer__shell\",\n      \"arguments\": {\n        \"command\": \"ls -la\"\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n→ Canonical event:\n```json\n{\n  \"role\": \"tool_call\",\n  \"tool\": \"developer__shell\",\n  \"content\": \"{\\\"command\\\":\\\"ls -la\\\"}\",\n  \"tool_id\": \"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\"\n}\n```\n\n### 7.3 Tool Response → tool_result Event\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"toolResponse\",\n  \"id\": \"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\",\n  \"toolResult\": {\n    \"status\": \"success\",\n    \"value\": [...]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n→ Canonical event:\n```json\n{\n  \"role\": \"tool_result\",\n  \"tool\": \"developer__shell\",\n  \"content\": \"...\",\n  \"tool_id\": \"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\"\n}\n```\n\n### 7.4 Tool Correlation\n\nTool requests and responses are correlated by the `id` field:\n- `toolRequest.id` == `toolResponse.id` → Same tool interaction\n- ID format: `toolu_<random>_<base62>`\n- AgentScribe matches these to create complete tool call + result pairs\n\n---\n\n## 8. Implementation Notes\n\n### 8.1 Current Implementation Status\n\n**What Works:**\n- ✅ JSONL parsing for standard message lines\n- ✅ Field mapping for timestamp, role, content\n- ✅ Static field assignment (source_agent)\n- ✅ Project detection with `ParentDir` method (fallback)\n\n**Implementation Gaps:**\n- ⚠️ **Field-based project detection for JSONL**: `ProjectDetection::Field` is not fully implemented for JSONL format (parser returns `None` for field-based detection)\n- ⚠️ **First-line metadata extraction**: JSONL parser needs to extract `working_dir` from line 1 and store in ParseContext\n- ⚠️ **content[] array expansion**: Parser needs to expand content blocks into separate canonical events\n\n### 8.2 Current Workaround\n\nIf field-based project detection is not fully implemented, use `ParentDir` method:\n\n```toml\n[parser.project]\nmethod = \"parent_dir\"  # Uses parent directory of session file\n```\n\nThis is less accurate than using `working_dir` from metadata but works immediately.\n\n### 8.3 Differences from Other Agents\n\n| Aspect | Goose | Claude Code | Codex |\n|--------|-------|-------------|-------|\n| **Session metadata location** | Line 1 of JSONL | Separate `session-meta/<uuid>.json` file | Line 1 of JSONL |\n| **Project field** | `working_dir` | `cwd` | `cwd` |\n| **Timestamp format** | Unix timestamp (`created`) | ISO 8601 (`timestamp`) | ISO 8601 (`timestamp`) |\n| **Content structure** | `content[]` array with blocks | Embedded in message with `type` field | Nested `content[]` blocks |\n| **Tool calls** | `toolRequest`/`toolResponse` blocks | `tool_use` content blocks | `function_call`/`function_call_output` |\n| **Model tracking** | Not available | In metadata file | In metadata |\n| **Envelope unwrapping** | Not needed | Not needed | Required |\n\n---\n\n## 9. -la\"\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Fields:**\n- `type`: \"toolRequest\"\n- `id`: Tool correlation ID (matches with toolResponse)\n- `toolCall.status`: \"success\" or other status\n- `toolCall.value.name`: Tool name (e.g., \"developer__shell\")\n- `toolCall.value.arguments`: Tool parameters object\n\n→ Expands to `tool_call` canonical event\n\n#### Type 3: Tool Response Block\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"toolResponse\",\n  \"id\": \"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\",\n  \"toolResult\": {\n    \"status\": \"success\",\n    \"value\": [...]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Fields:**\n- `type`: \"toolResponse\"\n- `id`: Tool correlation ID (matches with toolRequest)\n- `toolResult.status`: \"success\" or other status\n- `toolResult.value`: Tool output (can be nested content blocks)\n\n→ Expands to `tool_result` canonical event\n\n---\n\n## 5. Field Constraints and Validation\n\n### 5.1 Timestamp Field\n\n**Field name:** `created`\n\n**Acceptable values:**\n- Format: Integer (Unix timestamp)\n- Unit: Seconds since epoch\n- Example: `1747178328`\n\n**Constraints:**\n- Must be parseable as integer\n- Represents seconds (not milliseconds)\n- No ISO 8601 format support\n\n### 5.2 Role Field\n\n**Field name:** `role`\n\n**Acceptable values:**\n- `\"user\"` - User message\n- `\"assistant\"` - Assistant message\n\n**Constraints:**\n- Required on all message lines\n- Must be lowercase string\n- No other roles supported (no \"system\", \"tool\", etc. in base role field)\n\n### 5.3 Content Field\n\n**Field name:** `content`\n\n**Acceptable values:**\n- Format: JSON array of content block objects\n- Each block must have `type` field\n- Supported types: \"text\", \"toolRequest\", \"toolResponse\"\n\n**Constraints:**\n- Required on all message lines\n- Must be valid JSON array\n- Cannot be null or undefined\n- Array can contain multiple blocks (e.g., text + toolRequest)\n\n### 5.4 Project Field (working_dir)\n\n**Field name:** `working_dir`\n\n**Acceptable values:**\n- Format: Absolute file path string\n- Example: `\"/home/coding/projects/my-app\"`\n\n**Constraints:**\n- Located in line 1 only (session metadata)\n- Must be absolute path (starts with `/`)\n- Should be valid directory path\n- Not present on message lines\n\n---\n\n## 6. Examples and Default Values\n\n### 6.1 Complete Example Session File\n\n```jsonl\n{\"working_dir\":\"/home/coding/projects/my-app\",\"description\":\"Debug memory leak in worker process\",\"message_count\":4,\"total_tokens\":1250,\"input_tokens\":980,\"output_tokens\":270}\n{\"role\":\"user\",\"created\":1747178328,\"content\":[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"I'm seeing a memory leak in my worker process. Can you help me investigate?\"}]}\n{\"role\":\"assistant\",\"created\":1747178334,\"content\":[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"I'll help you investigate the memory leak. Let's start by checking the current memory usage and looking for potential issues.\"},{\"type\":\"toolRequest\",\"id\":\"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\",\"toolCall\":{\"status\":\"success\",\"value\":{\"name\":\"developer__shell\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":\"ps aux | grep worker\"}}}}]}\n{\"role\":\"user\",\"created\":1747178334,\"content\":[{\"type\":\"toolResponse\",\"id\":\"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\",\"toolResult\":{\"status\":\"success\",\"value\":[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"USER       PID %CPU %MEM    VSZ   RSS TTY      STAT START   TIME COMMAND\\ncoding    1234  2.5  8.5 123456 87654 pts/0    R+   10:30   0:15 node worker.js\\n\"}]}}]}\n```\n\n### 6.2 Default Values\n\n| Field | Default Value | Source |\n|-------|---------------|--------|\n| `source_agent` | `\"goose\"` | Static field in parser config |\n| `model` | `null` | Not available in goose logs |\n| `project` | Extracted from `working_dir` or parent directory | Project detection method |\n| `file_paths` | Extracted via regex from content | `content_regex = true` |\n\n---\n\n## 7. Event Expansion Rules\n\nAgentScribe expands goose content blocks into canonical events as follows:\n\n### 7.1 Text Block → Message Content\n\n```json\n{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"Hello world\"}\n```\n\n→ Canonical event:\n```json\n{\n  \"role\": \"user\",\n  \"content\": \"Hello world\"\n}\n```\n\n### 7.2 Tool Request → tool_call Event\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"toolRequest\",\n  \"id\": \"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\",\n  \"toolCall\": {\n    \"status\": \"success\",\n    \"value\": {\n      \"name\": \"developer__shell\",\n      \"arguments\": {\n        \"command\": \"ls -la\"\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n→ Canonical event:\n```json\n{\n  \"role\": \"tool_call\",\n  \"tool\": \"developer__shell\",\n  \"content\": \"{\\\"command\\\":\\\"ls -la\\\"}\",\n  \"tool_id\": \"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\"\n}\n```\n\n### 7.3 Tool Response → tool_result Event\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"toolResponse\",\n  \"id\": \"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\",\n  \"toolResult\": {\n    \"status\": \"success\",\n    \"value\": [...]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n→ Canonical event:\n```json\n{\n  \"role\": \"tool_result\",\n  \"tool\": \"developer__shell\",\n  \"content\": \"...\",\n  \"tool_id\": \"toolu_bdrk_01H6Vzjip2dzWDWJMQkiwevZ\"\n}\n```\n\n### 7.4 Tool Correlation\n\nTool requests and responses are correlated by the `id` field:\n- `toolRequest.id` == `toolResponse.id` → Same tool interaction\n- ID format: `toolu_<random>_<base62>`\n- AgentScribe matches these to create complete tool call + result pairs\n\n---\n\n## 8. Implementation Notes\n\n### 8.1 Current Implementation Status\n\n**What Works:**\n- ✅ JSONL parsing for standard message lines\n- ✅ Field mapping for timestamp, role, content\n- ✅ Static field assignment (source_agent)\n- ✅ Project detection with `ParentDir` method (fallback)\n\n**Implementation Gaps:**\n- ⚠️ **Field-based project detection for JSONL**: `ProjectDetection::Field` is not fully implemented for JSONL format (parser returns `None` for field-based detection)\n- ⚠️ **First-line metadata extraction**: JSONL parser needs to extract `working_dir` from line 1 and store in ParseContext\n- ⚠️ **content[] array expansion**: Parser needs to expand content blocks into separate canonical events\n\n### 8.2 Current Workaround\n\nIf field-based project detection is not fully implemented, use `ParentDir` method:\n\n```toml\n[parser.project]\nmethod = \"parent_dir\"  # Uses parent directory of session file\n```\n\nThis is less accurate than using `working_dir` from metadata but works immediately.\n\n### 8.3 Differences from Other Agents\n\n| Aspect | Goose | Claude Code | Codex |\n|--------|-------|-------------|-------|\n| **Session metadata location** | Line 1 of JSONL | Separate `session-meta/<uuid>.json` file | Line 1 of JSONL |\n| **Project field** | `working_dir` | `cwd` | `cwd` |\n| **Timestamp format** | Unix timestamp (`created`) | ISO 8601 (`timestamp`) | ISO 8601 (`timestamp`) |\n| **Content structure** | `content[]` array with blocks | Embedded in message with `type` field | Nested `content[]` blocks |\n| **Tool calls** | `toolRequest`/`toolResponse` blocks | `tool_use` content blocks | `function_call`/`function_call_output` |\n| **Model tracking** | Not available | In metadata file | In metadata |\n| **Envelope unwrapping** | Not needed | Not needed | Required |\n\n---\n\n## 9.
